Hi Susan / Devon —

Thanks again for the quick intake call last week. Wed like to lock in a POC kickoff that combines a short walkthrough of the Redwood inference flow and a hands-on session for prompt routing and a small load validation. Proposed slots (all in PST):

- Tues Jan 18, 10:00–12:00 PST (preferred)
- Thu Jan 20, 13:00–15:00 PST (alternate)

High-level agenda (attached):
1) 15m introductions & success criteria
2) 30m demo: routing/variants and KV-prefix caching
3) 60m hands-on: prompt review + integration checklist
4) 15–30m mini load run (target: 50 concurrent clients, short bursts)

Beforehand wedll need:
- A primary POC contact and an infra contact for port/KV access
- A small sample dataset (anonymized) or a few sample prompts

Ive attached the proposed agenda (20280109_poc_agenda.pdf). If one of the slots works, well send a calendar invite with a short pre-read and the load-test config.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Marcus

Team — heads up: ClearLogic picked Jan 18 at 10:00 PST. A couple of notes and requests before I confirm with them: 

- Lauren: can you lead the prompt review and be owner for the hands-on segment?
- Dev: can you prepare a short KV/load config (well run a 3-minute burst test targeting ~50 parallel sessions) and a list of ports/IPs to share with the customer. Please attach the config (kv-loadtest-config.yaml) to the invite.
- Stephanie: security pre-read — can you draft a 1-paragraph summary of our data handling (SOC/SLA points) and share a link to the standard evidence pack?

Timing: Id like to keep the mini load validation in the last 20–30 minutes to avoid disrupting the hands-on flow. If we need a longer load run we can schedule a separate window the next day.

If youre blocked on anything raise it here; Ill confirm the slot and assemble the invite.

— Marcus
